messages:
Priyanka (CS): Hi all — kicking off Thicket Labs onboarding. Zoe (PM) wants a tight 3-week pilot: 1) embeddings-driven KB search in agent UI, 2) suggested reply snippets for high-volume billing issues, 3) reduce escalations by 30%. Renewal review in ~52 days so we need renewal-facing metrics. Can owners volunteer for integration, runtime, and enablement?

Zoe (Thicket): Thanks Priyanka. Goals: 30% lower escalations, precision@5 >0.72 for KB hits, and p99 chat latency under 220ms. We'll provide a sanitized KB export + 48h transcripts by EOD tomorrow. Target kickoff in 9 business days.

Omar (Solutions): I'll own integration + prompt templates. Plan: Day0 access + schema map, Day4 prototype endpoint + UI smoke, Day11 retrieval tuning + evals, Day18 canary run. Need to know auth (API key vs OIDC) and preferred sampling fraction for transcripts.

Lee (Eng): I'll take runtime sizing, batching and canary rollout. Suggest hosted prototype; prepare private fallback if compliance shows up (adds ~2w). Action for Zoe: send avg concurrent agents and peak qps.

Hana (Enablement): I'll run a 60m hands-on session and produce a quick runbook + FAQ. Need two agent power users to shadow during canary.

invite-bot: Calendar invite created: "Thicket Labs Onboarding Kickoff" in 48h with Zoe, Priyanka, Omar, Lee, Hana.

Priyanka (CS): Risks noted: procurement/renewal at ~Day52; private deployment increases timeline; embedding index cost if full KB ingested. We'll prioritize metrics tied to renewal (escalation reduction & precision).

Omar (Solutions): Cost ballpark: prototype sampling ~45k tokens/week; full pilot with daily embedding refresh ~190k tokens/week. I'll propose a 10% sampling plan to control spend.

Lee (Eng): Action items for Zoe: KB export format, avg doc length, concurrent agents, and PII status. Also confirm desired embedding refresh cadence (daily vs weekly).

Zoe (Thicket): Will send KB export + doc stats tomorrow morning. No PII in samples. Concurrent agents avg 7, peak 20. Daily refresh OK for pilot.

Priyanka (CS): Pinned summary:
```
Owners & Due Dates:
- Omar: integration + prototype smoke (due Day4)
- Lee: runtime sizing + canary plan (due Day9)
- Hana: enablement workshop + runbook (due Day15)
- Zoe: KB export + transcripts (due Day1/EOD)
- Priyanka: pilot dashboard & renewal metrics (due Day3)
Risks: procurement review ~Day52; private deployment adds ~2w; embedding storage cost if full KB used.
Success criteria (Thicket): 30% escalation reduction, precision@5 >0.72, p99 <=220ms
```
I'll post a one-pager and create a tracker doc after kickoff. Ping me to swap owners or flag blockers. :white_check_mark:
